FourHSCTpatientsnotrandomizedcontrol: P3matchedsibling99%chimerism18mfollowupalivewell; P6firstgraftrejected,second99%,diedsepsis1maftersecond at25m; P14alive6yfollowupwithweakness/shortstature; P16graftrejectedalive5ywithsevereNDD. Observationalcurvescannotestablishcomparativetreatmentcausality. Figure3captionfiveyearsbutaxis300months, noat-risk/censor/CIinformation.

Critical timing: P16publishedS2baselineCD4/CD8=1.05, butpreprintHSCTS3lateCD4=7%,CD8=28%→0.25. Thus invertedratio supportis time-dependent and NOTcategoricallycontradicted. P15baseline1.5with322/210 contradicts itsinvertedratioassertion; noalternate measurement found.

P16packetlastencounter11monthsis diagnosisage; bothpublishedS1andHSCTS3last5years. P6packet2yearsrounds25mdeathinHSCTS3; publishedS1itself2y. P5publishedS1diarrhea– versus publishedS3persistentdiarrhea+: internalconflict, notunqualifiednegative.

Otherpublishedtableinconsistencies: P9ENT– versusS3recurrentotitis; P18pneumonia– versusS3recurrentpneumonia; P17ANC108000>WBC15800; P2ALC400<CD32457(samplingtimeunclear); P8CD4/CD8listed1.1 vs150/1525~0.098. Do not silentlyrepair cells. Units/normalranges include typographicproblems; renderedcellalignmentchecked.

Preprint-to-finalchanges matter: clinicalP15pneumonia– andneuro– become pneumonia+,hypotonia/brainatrophy; P14ataxiaandP13NDDadded; P5CMVcolitisandEnterobactersepsismadeexplicit; P10last41→42y.
